sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: 📊 "Structure" filters: after expanding or collapsing one cell, picking "▶ collapsed multi-row cells" (or "◀ expanded multi-row cells") again showed the rows from before the toggle — the count in the dropdown had already updated, so it read e.g. 45 while 46 rows stayed on screen.
Expanding a cell while one of those entries is filtering now removes that row, instead of leaving it listed under a state it no longer has.
The five places that record a cell's expand/collapse state are now one, so the dropdown counts and the filtered rows cannot drift apart again.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: ShowAllEntityData_HELP.txt: the Structure entries now state that they follow the ▶/◀ toggles live.
